ANNOTATIONS
1 MINIMIZED state: a small (~52px) launcher pinned bottom-right WITHIN the task-detail view (drag to any corner; position persists per
task). The status ring shows the task's live state. Calm by default — pulses ONCE on new attention, never with reduced-motion.
2 SCOPE = THE ROUTE. The bound task id always equals the /tasks/[taskId] URL param. There is no stored, mutable scope that can drift,
so a mutation can only ever target the task you are currently viewing. No "following" chip, no detach, no scope-switch UI.
3 The launcher shows the current TASK TITLE (solid, not dashed) — it is unambiguously about this task, the page you are on.
4 ROUTE UNMOUNT: navigating to Tasks list / Projects / Chat / Workflows / Settings REMOVES the dock and its launcher entirely.
The persistent server-side task-control conversation survives; it REOPENS (same transcript + decision state) when you return to t_8821.
5 Task A → Task B: navigating straight from one task detail to another REBINDS to B's conversation (brief header transition); A is never
silently retained. Per-task open/minimized state may be remembered; otherwise the dock defaults to minimized on entry.
6 Attention badge (amber !) mirrors the Cockpit Attention hero (shared source) — the two can never disagree. Unread messages use a
plain count. Keyboard: `A` toggles the dock (task routes only); FAB is last in the task view tab order. Off task detail: normal notifications.
